text:
claire: hey team — quick PSA from this morning: my puppy decided my USB mic was a chew toy mid-demo. mic alive but cable mashed and audio dropped. pics attached of the perpetrator. :dog: :broken_heart:
omar: oh nooo :sob: is the mic salvageable? did it disconnect or did the USB port get angry?
claire: it disconnected, zoom went into this weird reconnect loop and the host kept asking if i was on mute. switched to laptop mic and limp-wristed it through the rest of the meeting.
tessa: yikes. pro tip: in Zoom settings, set a fallback device (built-in mic) and uncheck "automatically adjust microphone" so it doesn't try to hunt for the broken device mid-call.
brandon: keep a spare headset or lav in a drawer labelled "meeting emergency". also a tiny USB extension cable is a cheap sacrificial cable for exactly this scenario.
claire: ran a quick ping test while i was troubleshooting so i could rule out network weirdness. pasted sample below: 
```
PING 1.1.1.1 (1.1.1.1): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=1 ttl=57 time=19.6 ms
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=2 ttl=57 time=20.1 ms
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=3 ttl=57 time=21.0 ms
--- 1.1.1.1 ping statistics ---
3 packets transmitted, 3 packets received, 0.0% packet loss
```
claire: so network was fine — purely hardware + canine enthusiasm. ordered a cheap lav on prime and a short sacrificial USB cable.
omar: gif: smug dog wearing headphones :laughing: 
tessa: also if you need temporary gear right away, ping @it-support in #help — we can ship a loaner headset same-day in many regions.
it-support-bot: note: to request loaner audio hardware, open a ticket in #help with subject "loaner headset" and include your shipping address. for damaged company assets, include serial and photos for replacement processing.
brandon: funny but practical: attach a cable clip under your desk so curious paws can't reach the cable. solved my cat-slap issues.
claire: adding "cable clips" and "puppy bribe treats" to my shopping list. thanks everyone for the quick recovery tips — demo survived. also dog now has a stern talking-to and a new chew toy. :raised_hands:
